description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a seed-stage tech startup that is building the modern operating system for global procurement. Backed by top venture investors, they have grown their customer base 5x in the past year and are now looking to scale rapidly. Their mission is to bring transparency and reliability to global supply chains. The team is seeking an early engineer to join them on the ground floor as they scale their product offering and customer base.
 
 Overview 
 The company has a bold mission: bring transparency and reliability to global supply chains. They are starting by building the modern operating system for procurement, helping businesses understand their supply networks and adapt to disruption.
 The company is a seed-stage tech startup backed by top venture investors. This past year, they have grown their customer base 5x, and they are looking to grow rapidly. Join the team on the ground floor as they scale their product offering and customer base.
 
 The Founding Team 
 Isaac Chambers 
 3x founder
 Started his career at Deloitte Consulting, focusing on supply chain & manufacturing operations for the aerospace & defense sector.
 Brent Shulman 
 Full-stack engineering leader
 Previously an engineer at Palantir and Pave
 While at Pave (where he joined as the 10th engineer), he founded, grew, and led the data integration team, scaling from 10 to thousands of customer connections.
 
 The Opportunity 
 As an early engineer, you will play a critical role in setting the company’s technical direction. You will be hands-on, building the early product and talking directly with initial customers and users. From the start, it is critical that you can build a 0-1 product with great UI/UX. As the company grows, you will own and lead the architectural roadmap that will lay the foundation for the platform. Your technical leadership will be a key factor in supporting and growing the engineering and product teams.
 You need to be both strategic and tactical. The company is seeking a builder to develop product specs and front-end components into an enterprise-ready application. They are also looking for a self-starter, not afraid to get their hands dirty and rapidly iterate on prototypes early in the development lifecycle. An ability to handle ambiguity is a must.
 The company needs a top-tier team to help build a platform that will fundamentally change and improve supply chain networks.
 
 Looking back on your first 12 months at the company, you will have: 
 Built and led the delivery of the early versions of the platform, spearheading pilot programs at initial customers
 Worked with the team to think through strategy and the evolution of the business
 Influenced new product and feature design while defining a long-term technical strategy aligned with industry best practices
 Designed and implemented platform integrations with outside APIs, partners, and cloud infrastructure
 Built something scrappily to show customer value, so that the team has now earned the right to re-architect for scale
 
 What the Ideal Candidate Brings to the Company 
 5+ years building across front-end and back-end
 Experience with modern, open-source tech (Typescript, React, Next.js, GraphQL, Trigger.dev)
 Startup experience and/or agency experience (bonus if it is in supply chain). Early-stage product experience building from zero to one
 Ability to build out various API integrations with speed
 Experience working with non-technical stakeholders and users. Comfortable leading and managing an engineering team
 Ideal experience includes previous work with various ERP system APIs
 
 Compensation 
 Compensation includes equity.
 Base Salary: $150,000 – $225,000 per year
